find: for (const k of head.matchAll(/\b(?:import|export)(\s+type)?\b/g)) typeOnly = k[1] !== undefined;
replace: for (const k of head.matchAll(/\b(?:import|export)(\s+type)?\b/g)) typeOnly = k[1] !== undefined || k[0] === 'export';
killedBy: developer modules stay off ordinary paths (issue #946) the ban reports a named re-export
developer modules stay off ordinary paths (issue #946) the ban reports a star re-export
why: The shared extractor reads every `export ... from` as type-only, so a re-export of a developer module goes free: the shape the pinned inventory before #1016 did not match, and one that puts the module in the bundle. The #946 ban takes its specifiers from the layer scan's `specifiersOf` rather than a regex of its own, so this is where it would go blind to re-exports. The real tree re-exports no developer module, and the layer scan's fixtures still pass (its re-export fixture is root-absolute, refused before the type check), so the two re-export fixtures of the ban are what fail.
